item.title: Hippo Cove at Cincinnati Zoo reopens with protective measures following beloved hippo Fiona's death

item.description: Mikaela Shiffrin returns to Killington, Vermont, this weekend, a place of both triumph and trauma for her.

item.title: An Amtrack train collides with a semitruck in Louisiana, injuring 5 people
item.description: Authorities in Louisiana say an Amtrak train collided with a truck, injuring five people. The collision occurred Sunday when the train collided with an 18-wheeler east of Lafayette.

item.title: US flew drone over Mexican territory to help capture drug lord in Sinaloa
item.description: Mexican security officials say the United States flew a surveillance drone over Mexican territory to help the government track down and capture a top drug lord over the weekend in Sinaloa.

item.title: Trump orders the Army not to detonate bomb-making chemicals in Iowa without court approval
item.description: President Donald Trump says he will defer to a federal appeals court on whether to proceed with detonating degraded bomb-making material at an Iowa ammunition plant.
